AIKit.behavior: Selection-scoped AI chat, direct edits, grouped AI changes, streaming cleanup, mod+j. Park unanswered workspace calls until their original material returns. Supersede unrun calls after a newer user message. Reuse recorded mutation results instead of repeating edits across remounts, reloads, or tabs. Store-backed mutations wait for the matching registered editor to finish loading, so refetching cannot overwrite an acknowledged edit. Tool-driven tab focus records the assistant origin. Manual focus records the user origin. Mutation run keys include the conversation ID. Invalid non-worksheet variant calls reach validation without waiting for store hydration.
AIKit.savedData: AI anchors are transient. Text, block and property proposals persist. listStart alone is derived. Client call-run results and parked turn records use separate localStorage ledgers, outside document content.
